mapper.select: SELECT SLOT_NO , SLOT_START , SLOT_END , SLOT_LABEL FROM TIME_SLOT ORDER BY SLOT_NO
SELECT SLOT_NO FROM RESERVE WHERE RESERVE_DATE = #{date} AND RESERVE_STATUS != 'C'

SELECT R.RESERVE_NO , R.MODEL_NAME , R.MEM_ID , R.TECHNICIAN_ID , R.CATEGORY_NO , R.RESERVE_DATE , R.SLOT_NO , T.SLOT_START , T.SLOT_END , T.SLOT_LABEL , R.REGIST_DATE , R.SYMPTOM , R.RESERVE_STATUS , R.VISIT_ADDR , R.VISIT_ADDR_DETAIL FROM RESERVE R JOIN TIME_SLOT T ON R.SLOT_NO = T.SLOT_NO WHERE R.RESERVE_NO = #{reserveNo}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(RESERVE_DATE, '%H:%i') FROM RESERVE WHERE DATE(RESERVE_DATE) = #{date} AND RESERVE_STATUS != 'C'
SELECT MEM_ID , MEM_NAME , TEL , ADDR , ADDR_DETAIL FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId}

SELECT R.RESERVE_NO , R.MODEL_NAME , R.MEM_ID , R.TECHNICIAN_ID , R.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , C.PRODUCT_TYPE , R.RESERVE_DATE , R.SLOT_NO , T.SLOT_START , T.SLOT_END , T.SLOT_LABEL , R.REGIST_DATE , R.SYMPTOM , R.RESERVE_STATUS , R.VISIT_ADDR , R.VISIT_ADDR_DETAIL FROM RESERVE R JOIN TIME_SLOT T ON R.SLOT_NO = T.SLOT_NO JOIN CATEGORY C ON R.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO WHERE R.MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY R.RESERVE_DATE DESC, R.SLOT_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(CATEGORY_NO) FROM RESERVE GROUP BY CATEGORY_NO ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO DESC
